usage:

evidence.reason: Plan argument changed from "monthly" to "benchmark", altering the plan-dependent branch in the metering pipeline; no test covers "benchmark".
Default multiplier changed from configuration.rate to 0, silently changing behavior for all callers that omit the multiplier argument.
Shared reference point between subscriptionCharge and usageCharge; both edits flow through this symbol, so their effects are not independent.
Test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0 but does not pin the plan label or default multiplier, so it cannot detect the behavioral drift.

result.userExplanation: 这两处改动分别改了订阅计费的套餐标签和用量计费的默认倍率，虽然测试仍通过，但默认倍率从配置值变为 0 可能影响未显式传参的调用方，证据不足以完全确认安全。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/metering.ts#usageCharge 的默认 multiplier 恢复为 configuration.rate（或明确确认所有调用方都显式传参），并请 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 确认 "benchmark" 套餐标签是预期值，否则改回 "monthly"。
